name: chat-composer
title: Chat Composer
description: The box a person talks to an agent in: two lines at rest, + and Send inside, files above the text, steers waiting above the box, a notice on its top edge, and Send that morphs into Stop.

meta.whenToUse: Talking to an agent: a chat side panel, an agent's page, a full chat. Put Plan, the model and the memory ring in its meta line (ComposerMeta).
meta.whenNotToUse: A comment or a reply on a record (CommentComposer), or a one-line prompt in a popover (Textarea in an InputGroup).
